data.Q: Why did the citizens of Shechem set Abimelek as king over them?
data.A: Because Abimelek is related to the citizens of Shechem.
data.wrong_answer: Because Abimelek is the son of his female slave.

data.Q: From whom does fire go out to consume the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo?
data.wrong_answer: From the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo.

data.Q: Who is consumed by the fire that goes out from the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo?
data.wrong_answer: The citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo.

data.Q: Toward whom must the citizens of Shechem show honor and good faith?
Over whom did the citizens of Shechem set Abimelek as king?
